academic_integrity.en: Presenting text or solutions generated by artificial intelligence as one's own without appropriate attribution constitutes plagiarism under university regulations.
academic_integrity.zh: 将人工智能生成的文本或解决方案作为自己的成果提交，未进行适当标注与说明，在校规中明确被定性为抄袭不端行为。
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 学生纪律处分与抄袭界定规定

teaching_guidance.en: University guidance says that assessment must not be entirely outsourced to AI.
teaching_guidance.zh: 大学指引规定，考核不能完全外包给AI。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Academic Affairs Council instructions for teachers
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 教务委员会教师教学与评分指引

security_procurement.en: Microsoft Copilot Chat accessed via university credentials includes commercial data protection under the university's enterprise agreement.
security_procurement.zh: 通过学校账号访问的微软Copilot Chat享有大学企业协议项下的商用数据保护。
security_procurement.meaningZh: 云服务与企业级数据保护条款

do.en: Disclose your use or non-use of generative AI in all written submissions in accordance with instructions.
do.zh: 在所有书面作业中，按照指引如实声明是否使用了生成式AI以及具体使用情况。

do.en: Log in with university credentials to access Microsoft Copilot Chat if you are 18 years of age or older.
do.zh: 年满18周岁的学生可使用大学统一凭据登录并使用Microsoft Copilot Chat。

dont.en: Do not use artificial intelligence tools in maturity tests (kypsyysnäyte) under any circumstances.
dont.zh: 在任何情况下严禁在成熟度测试（kypsyysnäyte）中使用人工智能工具。

dont.en: Do not process personal data in Copilot.
dont.zh: 严禁在Copilot中输入或处理任何个人数据。

cl-university-of-helsinki-atrain-428.text: aTrain is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

evidence.quote: The aTrain application is available for the most sensitive data; users who wish to use it must contact Helpdesk.

cl-university-of-helsinki-avidnote-429.text: Avidnote AI assistant is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

evidence.quote: Avidnote is an AI assistant for research documents. The official library page gives University SSO login steps using firstname.lastname@helsinki.fi credentials.

cl-university-of-helsinki-currechat-430.text: CurreChat is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

evidence.quote: CurreChat is restricted for staff and teaching purposes, is available at curre.helsinki.fi/chat, and is in Microsoft cloud in the EU. Students normally lack access unless a teacher specifically requests its use in their course.

cl-university-of-helsinki-dall-e-431.text: DALL-E 3 via Microsoft Copilot is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

evidence.quote: University of Helsinki students and staff members over 18 have free access to Copilot with commercial data protection; the service allows image creation using the DallE-3 image generation model.

cl-university-of-helsinki-helka-ai-432.text: Helka AI search is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

evidence.quote: Helka's generative AI search enables searching for international scholarly online sources from Helka and is available in Helka.

cl-university-of-helsinki-kontra-433.text: Kontra translation engine is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: self hosted system.

evidence.quote: Kontra is the University of Helsinki language model-based machine translation service at translate.helsinki.fi, limited to the University network and requiring VPN. The service is located in the University's own data centre.

cl-university-of-helsinki-microsoft-copi.text: Microsoft Copilot with commercial data protection is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

evidence.quote: Microsoft Copilot with commercial data protection is available free to all University of Helsinki students and staff members over the age of 18 at copilot.cloud.microsoft. It is a Microsoft public cloud service for public/open data.

cl-university-of-helsinki-scopus-ai-435.text: Scopus AI is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

evidence.quote: The official library page lists Scopus AI as a Scopus add-on and provides a log-in-to-Scopus-via-Helka access path.

cl-university-of-helsinki-web-of-science.text: Web of Science Research Assistant is listed for University of Helsinki in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: not specified.

evidence.quote: The official library page lists Web of Science Research Assistant as a Web of Science add-on and provides a log-in-to-Web-of-Science-via-Helka access path.

coursework:hel-learning-rules-group.text: General rule permits AI use in teaching and learning if pedagogically justified; course coordinators decide on rules for their courses.
coursework:hel-learning-rules-group.summaryZh: 原则允许在教学与学习辅助中使用AI达成课程目标
coursework:hel-learning-rules-group.scope: Studies Service official teaching & learning guidelines

evidence.quote: As a rule, AI use is permitted in teaching and in support of learning. AI use must support the achievement of course learning outcomes and be pedagogically justified.
evidence.location: Using AI to support learning > Artificial intelligence guidelines in a nutshell

exams:hel-maturity-ban-group.text: AI use is forbidden in maturity tests.
exams:hel-maturity-ban-group.summaryZh: 成熟度测试严禁使用任何人工智能工具
exams:hel-maturity-ban-group.scope: Maturity test rules and course exam conditions

evidence.quote: In maturity tests, the use of AI is forbidden.
evidence.location: Using AI to support learning > Artificial intelligence guidelines in a nutshell

disclosure:hel-disclosure-mandate-group.text: In written work, students must disclose their use or non-use of AI according to separate instructions, even if individual courses do not specifically request it.
disclosure:hel-disclosure-mandate-group.summaryZh: 书面作品须按照指引如实披露是否使用了AI

evidence.quote: In written work, you must disclose your use or non-use of AI in accordance with separate instructions, even when not specifically instructed to do so in individual courses.
evidence.location: Using AI to support learning > Guidelines for disclosing generative AI use

privacy_data:hel-copilot-data-limits-gro.text: Personal data must not be processed in Copilot.
privacy_data:hel-copilot-data-limits-gro.summaryZh: Copilot及公共云服务严禁处理个人隐私与敏感数据
privacy_data:hel-copilot-data-limits-gro.scope: IT Helpdesk data classification and Copilot limits

evidence.quote: Personal data must not be processed in Copilot.
evidence.location: Generative AI at the University > Data protection

approved_tools:hel-supported-platforms-g.text: Microsoft Copilot Chat is provided to university staff and students over the age of 18 using institutional credentials.
approved_tools:hel-supported-platforms-g.summaryZh: 大学提供Copilot与CurreChat两套校级支持AI方案
approved_tools:hel-supported-platforms-g.scope: Campus supported platforms and library directory

evidence.quote: The University of Helsinki has two general-purpose generative AI solutions: Microsoft Copilot Chat, available for all students and staff members over the age of 18, and CurreChat, which is restricted for use for teaching purposes.
evidence.location: Generative AI at the University > Services

research_publication:hel-research-author.text: University guidance says that, in general, generative AI cannot be listed as a co-author.
research_publication:hel-research-author.summaryZh: 严禁将生成式AI列为学术出版物共同作者

evidence.quote: In general, GenAI cannot be listed as a co-author.
evidence.location: Use of Generative AI in Research > Dissemination

academic_integrity:hel-cheating-definiti.text: Official cheating and plagiarism policy defines presenting text or solutions generated by artificial intelligence as one's own as plagiarism.
academic_integrity:hel-cheating-definiti.summaryZh: 伪称AI生成内容为自主成果在校规中定性为抄袭

evidence.quote: Presenting text or solutions generated by artificial intelligence as one’s own
evidence.location: What is cheating and plagiarism? > Forms of plagiarism

teaching_guidance:hel-teaching-assessmen.text: University guidance says that assessment must not be entirely outsourced to AI.
teaching_guidance:hel-teaching-assessmen.summaryZh: 考核与评分绝不能完全外包给AI须由教师决策
teaching_guidance:hel-teaching-assessmen.scope: Academic Affairs Council instructions for teachers

evidence.quote: Assessment must not be entirely outsourced to AI.
evidence.location: Instructions for teaching > AI in the assessment of learning

security_procurement:hel-cloud-protectio.text: University enterprise agreement provides commercial data protection for Copilot Chat users.
security_procurement:hel-cloud-protectio.summaryZh: 大学账号凭据保证Copilot会话不用于训练外部模型

evidence.quote: Copilot Chat is a public cloud service provided by Microsoft which includes enterprise-grade data protection when accessed using university credentials.
evidence.location: Generative AI at the University > Data protection
